## Provide a detailed description of the feature

A clear description of what feature you desire and what it achieves.

A clear description of what you want to happen.
Include specific details like new configuration settings (`.conf` options) or in-game commands.

A clear description of any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, mockup designs, or screenshots about the feature request here.
